controls.name: Access Authorization and Logical Access Security
controls.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, and removes access to data, software, intellectual property, and other information assets in accordance with established policies and standards.
mitigations: Enforce server-side KMS encryption on all data storage layers (S3 buckets, EBS volumes, RDS endpoints).
Restrict permission boundaries on execution contexts to scoped, non-wildcard patterns.
Implement IAM role identity assertions restricting principal context permissions.

controls.name: User Registration and Access Management
controls.description: The entity registers, authorizes, modifies, and removes users and credentials to securely manage user authentication, restricting compromised administrative contexts.
mitigations: Enable automated annual key rotation on AWS Customer Managed Keys (CMKs).
Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all identity registry sets.

controls.name: Access Control Point Protections
controls.description: The entity restricts physical and logical boundary access and shields corporate data repositories from public, general-purpose web indexing operations or malicious intrusion.
mitigations: Enable AWS S3 Custom Public Access Blocks forcing total access isolation.
Limit storage configuration buckets strictly to authorized internal roles or VPC gateways.
Verify public read access blocks are configured consistently.

controls.name: Network Bound and Ingress Protections
controls.description: The entity protects the network boundaries, network segmentation, and system integration points using ingress locks and restricted CIDR routers.
mitigations: Eliminate global ingress rules (0.0.0.0/0) directed at administrative port channels (Port 22 SSH, Port 3389 RDP).
Permit internet ingress strictly through secured reverse proxies, load balancers, or corporate VPN gateways.
